maddeler.e:
تسترضوا (form X)
# تَسْتَرْضُوا (tastarḍū) /tas.tar.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
# تُسْتَرْضَوْا (tustarḍaw) /tus.tar.dˤaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
